text:
Mia: Heads-up — planning frontend deploy (v2.14.1) today 15:30 PT. Goal: canary 10% for 20m then full. Need someone to run smoke checks, watch errors, and be ready to revert. We also need CDN invalidation for /assets/console/* and /static/js/*.

Ryan: I can run smoke and watch Sentry. I'll be online 15:00-16:00 PT. @Sam can you stand by for CDN purge if we need it?

Sam: I can do the purge and monitor infra metrics. If we need a manual purge, use Cloudflare:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$ZONE/purge_cache"
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  --data '{"prefixes":["/assets/console/","/static/js/"]}'
```
Quick smoke commands I run locally:
- curl -sSf https://console.redwood.ai/health || exit 1
- curl -sSf https://console.redwood.ai/login || exit 1
- curl -sSf https://console.redwood.ai/console || exit 1
- npm run smoke:ci (headless)

Anna: I'll own rollout gating and the canary slot. Canary config we'll use: rollout_percentage=10, canary_duration=20m. Gate on: JS error rate, 5xx rate (>2x baseline), p95 latency spike. If any gate trips -> immediate rollback.

deploy-bot: Deploy job created: job/fe-deploy/1823507723 scheduled for 15:30 PT. Canary slotting will be to cluster:fe-canary-10pct.

Mia: Timeline: 15:10 preflight (quick ping here), 15:20 tag + kick canary, 15:30 start deploy to canary, 15:35 run smoke, 15:50 decision to continue to 100% or rollback. If green, ramp to 100% at ~15:55.

Ryan: I'll prepare the PR and keep a patch for quick revert. My rollback command if needed: `kubectl -n frontend set image deploy/console console-image=redwood/frontend:v2.14.0` then trigger CDN purge.

Sam: Rollback sequence (condensed):
1) Pause rollout (if using controller) or set replicas to previous image.
2) Trigger CDN purge (Cloudflare command above) or Fastly purge_all if faster.
3) Verify health endpoints and metrics.
4) Post incident note in #incidents if user impact > 5%.

Anna: I'll post a short post-deploy checklist here after smoke: confirm Sentry, confirm p95/p50, check dashboard for error spikes, confirm analytics events.

Mia: Thanks everyone. I'll ping at 15:05 PT to start preflight. Please react with :thumbsup: if you're good or drop a quick no if you can't make it.

Ryan: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Anna: :thumbsup:
Mia: Great — see you all in 10.
